endorsements.quote: (1) Regulation should ensure AI developers disclose their training data and model architecture for full transparency.

unlisted_practices: Mandate shared data registries across demographic groups for collaborative monitoring and evaluation of AI system performance by AI vendors, healthcare deployers, patient groups, and independent auditing bodies.
Educate and certify stakeholders (vendors, deployers, patient groups, independent auditors) participating in collaborative AI monitoring.
Hospital administrators and healthcare deployers should evaluate teaming routines with AI and inform AI developers.
Develop explainable AI within practical medico-legal framings of accountability.
Disclose to patients, and offer choice regarding, the trade-off between explainability and accuracy in specific healthcare AI systems.

screen.reason: Perspective/commentary examining the gap between lifecycle regulation and implementation of AI in healthcare from early adopter experiences.
